changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[MapType]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [MapClass] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_MapType_MapClass] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_MapType_CreatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_MapType_UpdatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MapType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
